verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an on-device LLM inference engine. It offers local chat via a CLI, an OpenAI-compatible server, and desktop and mobile apps, so offline document chat is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions document ingestion, indexing, embeddings, or retrieval-augmented generation. Offline chat alone is an adjacent capability and does not deliver chatting with your own documents through automatic RAG.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
